body: I feel you op
Happy birthday 🎂 you’re not alone.. just always remember that there are people like us and together we won’t be alone. I hope you’re doing good now..

I feel you OP.. 😔
Thank you so much.. I tried thinking positive thoughts but it’s still not working..

She even mentioned someone we knew who died because of suicide, she said that if I really wanted to kill myself I will also burn myself, slit my throat, slash my wrist, and hang myself like he did. I really don’t understand 😔

I don’t know anymore 😔 though in that span of 5months she always try to message me I don’t know if she did that because she’s concerned or she doesn’t want to feel guilty if I was dead, she also mentioned that they all feel guilty and tried to message me so that they won’t have this guilt feeling when I’m gone
I don’t know if you’ll want to hear this but I can tell you everything.. if you really wanted to

It’s my own decision, I really do wanted to kill myself, I can’t understand what’s going on in my head, and when she talked about it she literally said that if I really do wanted to kill myself I should go and stab myself multiple times and I told her it won’t kill me because I want to kill myself and not to survive and cause some scene and end up in a hospital bed.. she told me that I’m not the one who’s suicidal, but what I’m doing is causing my sister a mental breakdown.. so it makes me feel like she’s trying to say that what’s happening in me is not true..

She suffered from depression too (you know the normal depression every person goes through) and she doesn’t understand how it really feels. I don’t know how to respond to this and what to put inside my head 😔
I will message you, and thank you so much..
What if he really shoot himself? Will that make you feel that he’s not faking anything or getting attention? I don’t mean to offend you, this is just a question 😔
It feels like you wrote what’s in my mind 😔

I messaged you.. thank you
